conventions.constraint: the backend wire form (type + fields), as GET .../constraints returns it
conventions.frame: start = input.start, then every earlier frame's expected.points laid over it; call: points = start + wish (wish replaces those ids), reference = start, anchors / stiff / pinned / provisional from input
conventions.expected: normative: unsupported, converged, the ids of points, each coordinate within the case's tolerance, variable_points, rows; informational: residual_inf (converged means <= tolerance * max(1, group diagonal)), exit, walks, rejected_steps, iterations
conventions.nearest: golden cases only, where known: the exact nearest feasible point (informational; the projector may stop a little short)

a whole line grabbed (both ends anchors): horizontal, length 10; r hangs off q at 5 and follows

20 distance-5 links from a pinned origin, nearly straight (an infeasible start: polished first), the tip pulled sideways and out: a singular start (the straight-chain bifurcation); the rescue step (spec 7.3) lets the tip swing round the pinned origin towards the hand (before F6 the walk stalled and nothing moved)
